mentions.name: kurpod
mentions.description: A tool for steganographically hiding thousands of images, PDFs, videos, secrets, and keys inside a single portable file that appears innocent, such as a vacation video named 'Vacation_Summer_2024.mp4'.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/srv1n/kurpod

Lets you hide 1000s of images, pdfs, videos, secrets, keys into a single portable innocent file like "Vacation_Summer_2024.mp4".
